name: OEP Vanilla MCTS (purchase, combat move, non-combat move)
description: Vanilla action-based MCTS of Justesen et al. (2018), the base of NE-MCTS and BB-MCTS, searching the purchase, combat move and non-combat move: UCT X + 2C sqrt(2 ln n / n_j) with C = 1/sqrt 2, epsilon-greedy rollouts (epsilon = 0.5) to the end of the turn rated with the heuristic, transposition table with edge statistics, descent-path BackupNegamax.
